best_match.fbbt_definition: Proximal medullary wide-field amacrine neuron that projects along M7 and branches extensively at the M7/M8 boundary with each branch projecting into medulla layer M9 where it forms an arbor with mixed bleb-type and fine terminals (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00003835 'proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm2', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
